name: XLSX Parse
description: Parse an Excel (.xlsx) workbook into rows. Provide the source ONE of three ways: path (an absolute file path on the Hearth host), data_url (a data:…;base64,… inline payload), or collateral_id (a workbook saved to Collateral). Optional: sheet (name or 0-based index; defaults to the first sheet), max_rows (cap returned rows). Returns headers + rows plus a row count.
author: hearth-team
